note: Frame -> book map for DAPA microfilms ZM34K-214 and ZM34K-215, read from the FILMS' OWN PRINTED TITLE CARDS, not from the paper inventory page. 1463 contiguous frames, M01068774-M01070236, no gaps. Located by scanning every frame for ink coverage: a title card is an isolated frame with ink<0.012 and mean>222. 12 of 13 declared book boundaries were flagged; the one miss (M01069505) is a 'nastavak' continuation, which correctly has no fresh card. ⚠ 7 October 2026: the range for Gračišće MKR 1746–1840 (sig 3.2) was M01070131–M01070236 and is corrected to M01070131–M01070226. The ink-coverage scan that built this map finds title cards; it does not find a «NASTAVLJA SE / TO BE CONTINUED» target, which is what M01070227 is. The last ten frames of reel 215 are a trailer of cards, not pages, and THE BOOK DOES NOT REACH 1840 ON THESE REELS.

books.ends: The REGISTER PAGES stop at M01070226, in May 1808 — NOT in 1840 as the book's own title card says. M01070227 is a filmed target reading «NASTAVLJA SE · TO BE CONTINUED», so the rest of this book (1808–1840) is on a reel this archive does not hold. Read frame by frame, 7 October 2026.

M01070227 «NASTAVLJA SE · TO BE CONTINUED»; M01070228 a laboratory production card; M01070229–233 title cards (Gologorica Status Animarum 1862 sig 7.2, 1894 sig 7.3, 1921 sig 7.4; Gračišće MKR 1667–1745 sig 3.1; Gračišće MKR 1746–1840 sig 3.2); M01070234–236 blank.
